newsitem.title: JAPAN: Foreign investors biggest yen bond buyers in Feb.
newsitem.headline: Foreign investors biggest yen bond buyers in Feb.

text.p: Foreign investors continued to be the biggest buyers of yen bonds in February, the Japan Securities Dealers' Association (JSDA) said on Friday.
Foreigners' net yen bond purchases in February totalled 1.7160 trillion yen, down from 2.0622 trillion yen in January.
A large amount of foreigners' buying, worth 1.4209 trillion yen, was in short-term bonds.
The figures include Japanese government bonds, notes and Treasury bills, corporate bonds and bank debentures, the JSDA said.
